notes: Corrected: *thee* in *to save thee* had been folded into מוֹשִׁיעַ's unit. Rule 44 makes a supplied object pronoun with no object morpheme its own `added` unit, as the chapter already does at 28.39 and 28.68.
מִלְּפָנֶיךָ splits three ways here because the ASV writes *face*; contrast the fused לְפָנֶיךָ of 28.7 and 28.25.
